title: Every actuality is bipolar, physical and mental

statements.text: Each actuality has a physical pole, its inheritance from the past, and a mental pole, a conceptual reaction that values, emphasizes and introduces novel contrasts. Mentality is not spatial, but it is always a reaction from and integration with spatial physical experience.

sources.quote: Each actuality is essentially bipolar, physical and mental
So though mentality is non-spatial, mentality is always a reaction from, and integration with, physical experience which is spatial.
